ranking_ties: score descending, symbol ascending; fixed before execution quotes
schedule: last open session of completed W-FRI weeks; execute next open session close
insufficient_names: if fewer than 50 scored names, all K arms of that strategy hold; never substitute execution-day names
execution: fractional-share research replay; missing quotes block trades, carried prices value existing shares; retain unfilled target cash; not the integer-lot forward ledger

random_subset.pool: top min(100, available scored names) at each signal, minimum 50
random_subset.method: fresh seeded permutation each signal and replicate, nested first K across all five K; replay entire paths with fees
random_subset.interpretation: conditional selection sensitivity, NOT confidence intervals or independent OOS trials

comparison_rules.interpretation: descriptive decision aids, not statistical significance or automatic live approval

limitations: current provider snapshots filtered by announcement date are not original vintage financial archives
historical industry intervals are used as supplied; no backward fill of today's industry; incomplete taxonomy/version history must be reported
missing financial factors retain production available-component behavior; do not silently manufacture a replacement factor
FREE_CASH_FLOW_YIELD is the existing operating cash flow per share / price proxy, not FCFF or FCFE yield
no historical limit-up/down, full suspension feed, stamp tax schedules, minimum fees, lots or market impact simulation
carried marks of permanently unquoted holdings can overstate liquidation value; report stranded positions and zero-value terminal sensitivity
retrospective diagnostic, not a new unseen holdout; forward account configuration unchanged
